title: API Keys
subtitle: SDK keys issued by the e2b-compatible gateway. Each key is bound to a set of templates: it can only create, list and operate sandboxes of those templates.
empty: No keys yet. Create one to let an SDK client in.
noTemplates: no templates — key cannot create sandboxes
confirmDelete: Delete key "{{name}}"? Clients using it will get 401 immediately.

form.title: Create API key
form.desc: The key is generated by the gateway (e2b_ + 40 hex, the format the e2b SDK validates).
form.name: Name
form.templatesHint: Aliases are resolved against the template list; a key with no templates cannot create sandboxes.
form.noTemplates: No templates found on the cluster.
form.adminHint: bypasses the template check and can manage templates/snapshots
form.createdDesc: Copy it now and hand it to the client; it stays visible here (reveal) as well.

howto.title: Client configuration
howto.desc: Point any e2b SDK / harness at the gateway with these three variables; the template alias selects the sandbox image.
